nom: Peach Slices Super Fade Discoloration Serum

avis.texte: I have had dark spots and scarring for years + allergies and sensitive, oily skin. This stuff has seriously been the only thing to help. I've been using it since the start of May and I'm OBSESSED.
I used this to fade my hyperpigmentation around my mouth and any acne scars. It has worked beautifully and now I do not even need to use color corrector! I highly recommend !!!

I had hopes that this would help with my discoloration issues, but like most lower-level products I've tried so far, it doesn't do much of anything IF it does anything at all. To add insult to injury, they're packaging is deceptive. the size of the bottle gives the impression that you're getting a good amount of serum, right? didn't barely last over a month, whereas other brands I've used have a smaller bottle that's lasted 3+ months with twice-daily use. The pump is purposely short from the bottom, so if you want to get all the product out of the bottle, you have to take off the pump and try pounding the bottle upside down into the balm of your hand. I had to do that.... and that's when I realized how thick the bottle itself actually is. Basically, this is just a thicker plastic bottle with less product inside that accounts for the weight, so you're getting a lot less value than you think you are. Save your money and buy something else.

avis.titre: Holy grail to fading my stubborn hyperpigmentation
avis.texte: This discoloration serum has been my holy grail to fading my stubborn hyperpigmentation. I have noticed more smooth even tone complexion. It's light weight and doesn't leave that sticky feeling. I will purchase this product over and over again.
I've been using this on and around the b hole and I didn't mention it to my S/O. He asked me if I was bleaching. I think this counts as a peer reviewed study
I have tried so many different products to help with my dark patches/spots and this is THE ONE. Don't expect results overnight but you WILL see results.

For this price this stuff is honestly magic to me. I've noticed with consistent use my dark spots from post acne marks are definitely not as prominent and I definitely notice a difference when I don't use it for a while!
Love this serum. It is lightweight, has a smooth consistency and is very effective at fading my dark spots.

Lightens my discoloration spots, quick drying on my skin, loving the results am on my third bottle! Goes so great under everything! I've seen a difference in my skin feel, texture, and pigmentation. I would definitely recommend.
Amazing ingredients to help fade hyperpigmentation! Texture is milky and plush, love this product. I did run into an issue with the pump though but aside from that, I really enjoyed using it :)
Wow!! This works even better than advertised and lasts! I only have to use it every couple of days. It takes away the redness and calms the face and feels amazing. Thank you!!!

I notice a difference in just three days on some dark spots on my chin as well as an overall brightening effect on my skin. I'll keep using it consistently! I'm excited. Thanks for this product. Please keep it around.

The texture of this serum is lovely, it is light and absorbs well. I used the full bottle and honestly didn't see much of a difference. Sensitive skin friendly, no fragrance. I still love this brand though.

The product really helps lightening a decade old spot. The serum has a nice texture, is easily absorbed into the skin with no strong smell. I have only been using it for two weeks and saw some immediate result. I ordered two bottles to allow time for it to work. The only reason I give it a four instead of five star rating is that I wish the bottle is not in plastic.

avis.titre: Good for even tone and Great at soothing But…
avis.texte: I emptied the super fade discoloration serum and got subtle effects but what stood out the most for me is how soothing and calming it was because of the abundant soothing ingredients like madecassoside, allantoin, green tea leaf extract, licorice root extract, panthenol and cucumber for cooling. It makes it really good for calming your skin. My only problem with it was the pilling! I couldn't layer easily and I had to spread it very gently and wait about 5 minutes to set in. Definitely could improve in finish. Also the Tranexamic acid is a derrivative so the effects are more subtle and slow.
Unfortunately, it did nothing for me after using it for 3 weeks.

This lightened my underarms so fast! I'm using it twice a day, am & pm. I wish I took before and after shots. It's seems to have plateaued at the shade I am now but still very happy with how quickly it lightened my dark underarms and inner thighs.

I rarely feel compelled to write reviews for products, but I was extremely impressed with this one! Not only is it price friendly, but it works within days! I have rosacea and visible blood vessels and acne scars on my face as a 42-year-old woman and was quite impressed with how even my skin tone looked after the first use. I've even gone so far as to go without foundation recently, and I attributed mostly to this product.

avis.titre: This is power in each pump
avis.texte: I was very surprised to notice in such a short period of time that my dark spots were fading. I've had these spots since I got chickenpox at a young age. They are actually fading. It's only been 2 1/2 weeks but I definitely notice a difference
I have acne scars on my cheeks from when i was a teenager. I have been using Super Fade consistently for nearly a month and they are all but gone!! I cant get over how well this product worked.
I have super sensitive skin so most scar fading serums i cant use. I use this dialy morning and night and ive noticed a difference in my acne scars in 3 weeks. Super lignt and gentle too.

avis.titre: Great Product for Mature Skin too
avis.texte: Peach Slices Super Fade Discoloration Serum appears to be good for all skin types. I have mature skin and sensitive skin and it hasn't irritated my skin at all. Great smooth, light weight consistency but yet still hydrating. After using for 3 days, I started to see a difference in my spots and discoloration they looked less pronounced. I will keep using this product as my daily routine, its great.
With my regular routine, adding this has been life changing! Will definitely buy again

I like using the serum, especially since TO's niacinamide starting giving me eczema, however, the packaging is poor. There is still so much inside that will not come out because the formula has thickened & it is practically impossible to reach the stuff stuck at the bottom. For that reason I will not repurchase.
I use this product daily. I have a sun spot on the right side of my face from all the driving I have done. This product is fading that spot!
This serum really works! I've been using for about 3 weeks and I can see my post acne hyperpigmentation leaving my skin. It's just wonderful.
It is a little drying but does an amazing job. It helps clear any dark spots and helps with discoloration.
Faded most of my dark spots and post-acne marks within a week! When used day and night the bottle lasts about 2 months.

I bought this stuff on a whim & I am glad I did! It has improved my skin 10 times over. It has reduced the appearance of my facial scars & reduced the redness. It has made my skin just brighter overall & made me look younger. What a bargain!

avis.titre: Great for sensitive and acne prone skin works IMMEDIATELY
avis.texte: I pick at my skin a lot and it leaves acne scars. They was a HUGE difference in how dark they were in 3 days. They're barely visible now! I also have sensitive skin and it didn't make me break out at all!
I put this on at night at wake up with the most even skin tone! It also has really great ingredients for the price point! Definitely recommend!

Been using PM only for two months. I really do notice a difference. My skin is brighter and has an even skin tone. Post blemish marks would last for months but i notice big spots diminishing a lot quicker. Even if i didnt have dark spots i would still use it for its brightening effects. I will be repurchasing!!
I got this product for my mom (55) and she's been using this for a few weeks and LOVES the results so far! She finds it's lightening her dark spots without drying out her skin!
This is works well, quickly. Doesn't cause irritation. A little goes a long way. I am able to use it twice a day without irritation. I use it along with retinol with no irritation.

avis.titre: DONT WASTE YOUR MONEY ON THIS!
avis.texte: This product actually doesn't even do nothing. I finish the whole bottle, because it says that it's for the dark spots. And it really didn't do anything at all. So for me, it didn't work.
This serum is insanely good. Its on the thicker side so its very hydrating and fades spots quickly. It has not caused irritation for me but everyone is different. So good for the price
after one use i already see the dark spots lightening. it's a nice milky serum not too thick and a little goes a long way so the bottle should last a while.

avis.titre: Maybe a good moisturizer but did nothing for the brown spot
avis.texte: Just the whole container. No reaction but also difference in my brown spots. Did not work for me

I would have loved to continue using it, however, it became congealed and the pump stopped being able to dispense the cream.

this is amazing. I use this with the slice peaches serum. my face started getting lighter after the first use. I am 44 and have battled acne scars and some brown skin. I have tried soooo many things and this is the only on to work. some complian of a smell, but its like the deodorant that smells like puke at first and fades. to me it smells like smoky fruit. it fades fast and works. looks great under makeup. I will buy this again and recommend it 1000 times over

This stuff is garbage!! I baught it to help with lighting up my age spots and instead got a face full of acne .I have aging skin and my face was clear to start . Dont waste your time on this product , its terribe

Brought this for my 10 year daughter as she is breaking out! Faded in about 2-3 weeks !
A little goes a long way, watery consistency and texture, haven't been using long enough to yield any results YET
I have purchased Super Fade twice because it lightens the marks on my face I caused in early years from abusing & bruising blemishes.

I've been using this product in and off for a few months. I was getting little break out around my mouth/where I applied it, so I stopped using it. For the past few days I've been dealing wi ty terrible cystic acne in the left side of my face where I applied it since I had the most discoloration there.

I've been using so many discoloration serums in this world now, ((Good Molecules Discoloration Serum, Inkey List's Alpha Arbutin, Hada Labo Whitening Lotion, & even the suuuuper expensive Allies of Skin Tranexamic Acid)) & ugh! None of them have worked on these 2 extremely stubborn pigmentation spots on my left cheek. I rly hope to GOD this one works :) I've always had faith in Peach Slices
Love this moisturizer. Its very hydrating and has slowly brighten my dark spots. Giving me an even tone.

It's helped to fade my dark spots (fresh and older ones) significantly, and I saw a lot of improvement in my skin tone after just 2 weeks of consistent use (once every AM). I use it regularly to maintain my skin tone texture.
ive been using it pretty consistently for a month now & i do see results. my sun spots on my cheeks did lighten!

i've been using this for nearly 2 months and have noticed tht the scarring on one side of my face has lightened without doubt but there seems to be not much effect on the more recent scars. i would recommend this as it is quite inexpensive and is considerably gentle enough to use it every day

This serum feels good on my skin, but I'm not sure if it does much of anything. Also, the color of it is not a "sunshine" yellow, but more of a snot yellow. When I dispense it, I can't look at it knowing I'm about to put it on my face.

I have had dark spots for a while and ended up buying this product in the third trimester of my pregnancy. I have sensitive skin and Within two weeks, I noticed a remarkable difference in my skin, it became clearer, brighter and more even! No itching burning or breakouts. I ran out and have not repurchased for a month now and my skin still looks clear! Don't think twice and just get it!

I have been using this a week straight to see if there's any difference on fading newly formed dark spots, but instead I got chemical burn on skins! Beware! I have sensitive skin and this destroyed my skin barrier.

This is the only product i have found that has helped my hyperpigmentation on my chin from plucking my beard! I will say that the product doesnt last that long but really cant beat the price! I have used this product 2x day for 2 months and i would definitely recommend!

What an amazing and affordable product! I cannot recommend Super Fade enough. I'm 60 years old and while I've worn SPF religiously for the past 15-20 years, I often didn't when I was younger. I've had some significant melasma/sun spots pop up and an especially stubborn area that didn't respond at ALL to my regular skin care regimen which includes AGA/BHA and glycolic acids, retinol, and various different skin care items claiming to be "brightening. " I'm not even half way through the bottle and a particularly stubborn spot, about the size of a quarter, is now 80-90% gone. When I first got this I applied it over my entire face nightly. Now I'm doing spot treatments every other night and full face application on the opposite nights. Amazing product. I've been an avid user of Paula's Choice products for ages, but I will be investigating more of Peach Slices offerings going forward. Thank you for making such an effective product available at such an affordable price! :u1F970:

I've had some stubborn blemishes on my face for years. I've tried many different products, but they usually irritated the area and made the blemishes more prominent. After using this product, I've noticed the dark spots starting to fade, and my skin tone looks more even.

avis.titre: Definitely an improvement very smooth & Love having a pump.
avis.texte: I not only used this super fade on my face, but also top of my hands and noticed improvement. It does pump out a little fast.

I haven't been using consistent enough to notice a fade in hyperpigmentation which is why I purchased it but I can attest to how AMAZING this product makes my skin feel. Definitely looking at more products from peach slices and peach & lily!
Been using this for almost two weeks now and I can already tell that my dark spots are fading.

I was skeptical about his product because it had mixed reviews but it was pretty inexpensive and the ingredients are great so I gave it a try… This product is great, i have already seen fading of my acne scars after using it day and night for 3 days. The key is to wear sunscreen during the day with it on

The Super Fade Discoloration Serum is a standout budget-friendly formula for fading hyperpigmentation and evening out skin tone. Anyone targeting post-acne marks, sun spots, hyperpigmentation, especially with oily or combination skin (the lightweight texture plays well with other layers). Result Driven.
Very light consistency. Used entire bottle and did notice lightening of dark spots
Had a stubborn purple lump on my cheek for 2 months. Usual retinol and LA serum didn't help. Tried this as a spot treatment and within 2 weeks, it's already lighter and smaller. Highly recommend!
All of my sun spots have been fading. It tries quickly goes on smoothly and is unscented. I highly recommend. I have purchased it more than once.
I never have bad reactions to skincare products but I had breakouts all over my face the day after trying this product out. So unfortunate, I love their snail toner.
I had some acne scarring causing darker pigmentation and after 2 weeks, I see noticible difference I'm very happy. I used twice a day and use the moisturizer too.

This broke me out so bad! I dont think any of the ingredients in this have purging properties like retinol, but this ruined my skin. I am not exaggerating when i say every time I used it I had a new breakout

It's a bit too soon to see any major results, but I'm liking this product so far. The texture is nice and light, and the formula is backed with plenty of brightening ingredients. The price is also really good for the quality
This one is definitely better than naturium tranemic acid serum but it's only been a week since i started using it, hasn't broken my skin out so lets see. Fingers crossed!
I haven't noticed a huge difference in my skin but it feels nice and I haven't gotten any severe acne since starting it.
genetic hyperpigmentation under eyes is clearing, same with my freckles!! im rly happu my skin looks more even :) no breakouts from my sensitive skin
The combination of niacinamide and Kojic acid in this product are giving me positive results.

I love peach and lily—use a couple of their products regularly. This is a nice benign serum. No pore clogging or irritation. But for me, despite somewhat sensitive skin, it is not strong enough. I maybe used half the bottle and expected some mild exfoliation now, with discoloration fading or brightening later, by the end of the bottle. I ended up ordering P&L's lactic acid power cocktail instead. Based on the ingredients and the co, I'm sure this is good for young, sensitive skin, but my mature skin needs a stronger acid.

avis.titre: Doesn't work the way it's intended
avis.texte: I've almost completely finished using one container of this serum, using it morning and night for a few weeks, and I have taken before and after photos and did not see any major differences in discoloration. My skin did feel less rough and healthier but that's about it.

I don't know if I'm delusional or what, but I swear I put this on a pimple mark and the next morning it faded a little. I have problems with pimple marks because I don't go outside much, so this was just the product I was looking for!!
I love the texture of this product. I haven't used long enough yet, to see any improvement.

I noticed the slight improvements on some recent, stubborn acne and acne scars, after the first few applications. I knew its fading effect wasn't going to be instantaneous, but seeing consistent improvement, especially so early on, was a good sign to me that it could actually do something. I've been using it consistently in the PM (maybe 4-5 days a week) for about 3 weeks now, and I definitely do see progress in minimizing the appearance of dark spots (reduction in size, color, helping it heal, etc.) The more consistent you are with it, the better. I have a lot of old acne scars from the span of my entire life (10+ years). I also scar easily from any new acne. My intention with this serum was to help my new acne scars/dark spots heal faster, and I can say it has definitely been helpful there. An ounce of prevention is worth a pound of a cure. So i'm using this to prevent new scars from staying with me for too long! Old acne scars and dark spots are always harder, and take longer to fade, so I'll keep using and have to see.

I returned home after living in a cold and windy place for many months, including winter. It didn't occur to me at the time, but my face was way drier than it used to be, which always shows up by pink spots on my cheeks. Part of it was also from reaction from a toner that I had used for 2 months (because I didn't have access to the Peach Slices Snail Toner I usually used!). So I got this serum to treat that redness from the dryness and reaction to the previous toner. I'm almost done with one tube, and it seems to be visibly working. The redness is disappearing quicker than when I was using my regular serum. I'll get a second tube to continue the restoration.

The product has a curdy look as if not well emulsified, and container does not have a safety seal. It seems to work but I don't feel comfortable buying it again unless they address these issues. The shipping cost is slso massive, making the price too much for this item.

I usually dont do reviews but damnnnnn this product…*Mwah* chef's kiss. Im a very anxious person and have been picking at my skin for years. I've recently stopped that bad habit but now im stuck with dark scars. I decided to give this product a try and WOW! Ive been using it twice a day for a month now and my skin has never been this clear. Obviously I still have scars but its not as noticeable anymore. Definitely give it a try!
Depending how noticeable the scars are it might take the whole bottle to start noticing it clearing up. It has helped me so far but im buying another one.

This had been working well for me in the past two weeks since starting, initially twice daily and then switching to daily. I did find it pilled a bit under makeup, so I started using it at night exclusively. I've had a couple stubborn areas that refused to budge even with my regular use of different acids, retinol, and consistent sunscreen usage. After two weeks, these areas have faded about 50%. Will continue to use because it's effective and affordable, plus works well as an adjuvant moisturizer. Recommend, will repurchase, and will also look into other products by this brand. Great product!
I have been using this product for about a month it's very gentle and most of my dark spots are gone!! Will be purchasing again!
Great product that effectively removes dark spots. It is lightweight and fragrance free which i love. The only con for me is it doesnt leave a dewy look

avis.titre: Early days but results are positive!
avis.texte: WOW, a product that actually works with my dark spots and hyperpigmentation! I've only been using a few weeks so far, but my skin seems to really respond to this super fade serum. I use it morning and evening and not only have the dark spots seemed to fade, but the texture of my skin is improved / super smooth as well!

I started using this as an alternative to glycolic acid because it was too harsh on my skin and was surprised when it actually worked better than the glycolic acid. I used it everyday in the morning and at night for a week before I noticed a difference which is quite fast compared to what I had been seeing with the glycolic acid toners. I have light-medium olive skin so my acne spots turn grey and are very apperant. The glycolic acid usually takes like a month before I notice a difference but this stuff was much quicker. Ive been using it on dark spots I gave on my arms and legs too and it's worked for them as well. This quickly became a holy grail.

avis.titre: Finally, a fading serum that works !
avis.texte: I've been using this product for about 3 weeks now and can def tell a difference in post acne dark spots and hyperpigmentation! I've tried so many products and this is the ONLY one that has worked

I have hormonal acne on my cheeks and chin that leaves brown spots (I have very yellow/olive coloring). The marks stick around for months, so I wasn't expecting much from this product but thought it was worth a try for the price point. I saw results in just a few days and my skin has continued look clearer and more even! It hasn't irritated or dried out my sensitive skin at all. I've even applied it along my bikini line where there is some hyperpigmentation from shaving and it has made a noticeable improvement. This product has given me back so much confidence, I definitely recommend.

I will be buying this again and again. I've struggled for years with dark spots and never seen a product work like this one. One month in and I'm seeing more improvement than I've seen after 6 months with other serums

I love the consistency of the Super Fade lotion. It's gentle and non irritating to my somewhat sensitive skin. I've only been using it for about a week so not seeing a real difference yet but I'll continue to use it - every am and pm after cleansing.

I have quite a bit of sun damage and several stubborn dark spots on the left / " driver's side" of my face - i purchased this and have been using it day and night for a few weeks and have seen definite results.
I notcied visible brightness and scar fading after using this nightly for a month! I will be repurchasing.
Have not seen any major changes for improvement in discoloration so will keep using, but skin is smooth and no new issue.

I've been using this lotion on my hands to lighten age spots for a couple weeks now, and they already appear to be lighter. I will continue to use until they've faded completely. I think it works well, especially as compared to other lotions I've tried
While I can see a tiny difference, I think I need to use it for a few more weeks. I was so hopeful so do want to see a marked difference
I cannot reocmmend this product enough! In just a couple weeks, the stubborn, bright red scars I've had for MONTHS have faded and shrinked and are barely noticeable!
The application and texture is nice. Lays well under other products. Haven't been using long enough to review long term effects.

avis.titre: Highly recommend for fading new dark spots

I've been using this product for almost a month and the dark spots have either completely vanished or lightened significantly. I use this morning and night after applying my serums and am happy with the results
I love it I was a bit skeptical since i have a sensitive skin but i dont regret buying it .

avis.titre: Nice texture, too soon to tell
avis.texte: Too soon to tell actual impact on skin but serum is nice, didn't irritate my skin or break me out

I use it day and night, making sure to use sunscreen with it during the day. not only is this affordable but effective! The Caudalie is more of a milky serum but this one is a little thinner. This isnt a problem for me because I use a milky toner prior to adding the serum. Will definitely be repurchasing when I run out.

This product has is surprisingly effective! I wasn't expecting much at the price point but this has put a lot of much pricier serums to shame

I started using this serum for my nightime routine and have been enjoying it. I don't see much of a difference in my skin yet but I do think that it absorb into my skin quickly without leaving my face feeling tacky or heavy and it works well with my mosturizer, which is a very basic formula. No reactions and happy to continue using this.

This stuff is truly magical! I had a lot of dark marks and this has cleared my skin after 3 uses! For the first time ever I have felt confident using only the Peach Slice Tinted moisturizer as "makeup" because that's all i need for coverage because of this product!
This is a light and easy to use product. I have noticed a reduction in the darkness of my age and acne spots. I typically use it once a day but you can use it am and pm.

avis.titre: My skin has never looked better!!
avis.texte: I have tried many products to try to brighten and lessen the appearance of my acne scars and this by far has been the best product I've ever used! I've already noticed changes and have had my friends comment on my skin looking super clear! Plus this wasn't expensive at all unlike a lot of other products. It also hasn't dried out my skin which is typically more on the dry side. If you want to try to fade your acne scars this product is the it!!! Honestly so happy I made this purchase!

My skin tends to pigment easily whether from a blemish, a scratch, or overdoing my retinol. I wanted to try something new to lighten the still offending spots. This lotion is lightweight and so far, non-irritating. It also layers well with my other P&L products. No pilling. It takes time for hyperpigmentation to lighten, but so far so good. I'll probably update my review after I finish the bottle.
I used this for a few weeks, it made my face more red, and caused breakouts where I was applying it. I do have sensitive skin, so if you do too this product may not be the best for you.

This serum is amazing, especially at the price point, and it plays well with my other products! i noticed my skin even out almost immediately, and I see my dark spots fading, and it's only been a little over a month.
This product has been unbelievable for my pie. Seriously an amazing product. I've been using it with the peach slices azelaic acid and a basic moisturizer and my skin is looking great.
